args.body:
Hi Linda,

Good news and bad news, but mostly timing. Batch invoicing is still coming — it ships as the headline item in release 2026.09.4 — but that release has been pushed from Thursday to Monday, September 28 at 02:00 UTC.

Here's what happened, in plain terms: during our staging test, a database migration (adding a column that batch invoicing needs) held a long lock on a large table. The staging copy is about a ninth the size of production, so we didn't want to risk that lock during business hours on the real thing. We're rewriting the migration so it adds the column without a default value and then backfills the existing rows in small batches, which avoids the lock entirely.

Nothing is broken right now — the current version of payments-api (2026.09.3) is live and healthy. This is purely a precaution to protect availability.

For Harrow & Finch: they should plan on batch invoicing being available Monday morning (UTC). If they're working a tight month-end close, that's the date to anchor to. If anything slips further I'll let you know immediately.

Feel free to forward this as-is if it helps.

Thanks,
Platform on-call
